title: Animated three-step explainer (16:9)
description: A 15-second 16:9 process explainer: a title with an accent rule, then three numbered steps that pop in on a self-drawing connector with a one-line note each, turn into check marks and come back together as a recap. Code-rendered (scene.steps) with a procedural lo-fi bed and a soft click as each step lands.

title.description: What the viewer will understand, under 40 characters

step_1.description: First step as a short imperative or statement, under 34 characters

note_1.description: One-line detail for step 1, under 60 characters

note_2.description: One-line detail for step 2, under 60 characters

note_3.description: One-line detail for step 3, under 60 characters

look.description: Visual look: night (dark, mint), paper (cream, vermilion), ocean (deep blue, cyan), citrus (white, amber)

scene.description: The step animation; rendered from the copy unless supplied

music.description: Music bed; produced procedurally unless a cleared track is supplied

click.description: Soft click as each step lands

copy_examples.brief: Explain how to brew pour-over coffee for beginners: rinse the paper filter with hot water, bloom the grounds with a little water for 30 seconds, then pour the rest slowly in circles. Title it 'Better pour-over in three steps'.

inputs.title: Better pour-over in three steps
inputs.note_1: Hot water removes the papery taste
inputs.note_2: A little water, then wait 30 seconds
inputs.note_3: Keep the bed evenly wet as it drains

copy_examples.note: Steps are short imperatives in the brief's order; each note adds the why or the number from the brief in one line. The requested title is used unchanged.

style.typography: Inter, bold labels with muted notes

direction.action: Title, three steps in order, then a recap with every step checked

notes: The animation is code (recipes/scene/steps) rendered frame-exactly on a virtual clock.
Clicks sit where each step node pops (1.1 s, 5.2 s, 9.3 s), derived from the recipe's intro, beat and recap timing at 15 seconds.

quality_gates.description: Integrated loudness lands within 1 LU of the -16 LUFS delivery target.
Decoded true peak stays at or below -0.5 dBTP after AAC encoding.
No stretch of blank picture (no visible contrast, any colour) lasts longer than 0.5 seconds.
A subject-matter reviewer confirms the steps are correct, complete and in the right order.
